Working closely with Regional Marketing, Sales, Channel teams and Mitel's global marketing functions, the successful candidate will coordinate and execute marketing campaigns, webinars, events and partner initiatives, ensuring effective delivery and alignment with local business needs. The role requires strong organizational skills, digital marketing expertise and a results-oriented mindset, with the ability to manage multiple activities, monitor campaign performance and contribute to continuous improvement. Main responsibilities Execute and optimize integrated marketing campaigns across digital channels (email, web, social media) supporting demand generation and customer engagement Support the execution of joint marketing plans with selected channel partners working closely with the channel sales team Coordinate and execute webinar programs including planning, execution follow-up and performance reporting Support the execution of Mitel France corporate events, partner events, trade shows and industry conferences Maintain and optimize the French marketing database, supporting data quality, segmentation, targeting and GDPR-compliant marketing practices Collaborate closely with sales and channel teams to support local marketing priorities, campaign activation and lead follow-up Work closely with regional and global marketing teams to ensure timely and effective execution of marketing activities Monitor and report on campaign performance, engagement, lead generation and pipeline contribution, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement Requirements Bachelor's degree 3-5 years of relevant B2B field marketing experience, ideally within technology, SaaS, telecommunications or another channel-led environment Experience in several of the following: digital marketing, channel marketing, events, integrated campaigns, demand generation Hands-on experience executing digital campaigns, particularly email marketing, social media, webinars and web campaigns Experience with marketing automation and CRM platforms (Marketo; Salesforce) is essential Experience in marketing demand generation tools such as 6sense and Demandbase is a plus Comfortable working with marketing data, segmentation, campaign reporting and KPIs Good understanding of GDPR and digital marketing data/privacy requirements Fluent French and English, both written and spoken Strong organizational and project-management skills with excellent attention to detail Collaborative and comfortable working across regional and international teams To ensure our hiring process is fair, efficient, and transparent, we want to inform all applicants that we may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies, including third party tools to screen resumes and match candidates to job opportunities based on their skills and experience. Mitel is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. Diversity makes sense for us, for our customers and for our future. review_candidates.title: Executive Producer - Brand Creative
review_candidates.description: In the early 1900s, Sergei Diaghilev transformed ballet by bringing together extraordinary artists across disciplines. He paired Stravinsky with Picasso, Coco Chanel with choreographers, composers with painters. He wasn’t the person on stage, but he created the conditions that made extraordinary work possible. Every production demanded creative ambition, difficult tradeoffs, relentless coordination, and uncompromising standards. Great creative production feels a lot like that. Mercury is building a financial company that people genuinely love to use. We’re combining thoughtful design, technology, and AI to make financial workflows simpler, more powerful, and more human. Our Brand Creative team exists to bring that ambition to life through everything we make. We’re looking for our first Executive Producer to establish Creative Production as a core capability within Brand Creative. You’ll lead production across our most ambitious campaigns and projects while building the systems and external network that allow exceptional creative work to happen again and again. You see production as a creative discipline. You know how to protect bold ideas, challenge underdeveloped briefs, make difficult tradeoffs, and bring clarity to complexity. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who wants to build the function while still personally producing our biggest creative bets. In this role, you’ll: Own production across Brand Creative campaigns and projects, balancing priorities, capacity, staffing, budgets, timelines, and risk across multiple concurrent initiatives. Personally lead our most ambitious campaigns and selected projects from concept through delivery across film, photography, motion, experiential, digital, and integrated work. Partner with creative leaders to turn ambitious ideas into production plans that hold up against timing, budget, and reality, challenging underdeveloped briefs and protecting the creative idea through execution. Build and lead an exceptional network of agencies, directors, studios, photographers, freelancers, and production partners that expands our capacity without lowering the bar. Establish how Brand Creative prioritizes, staffs, greenlights, reviews, and delivers projects, creating a production system that makes exceptional work more repeatable. Bring clarity to complex projects by keeping creative leaders and cross-functional partners grounded in the real state of the work, decisions, constraints, tradeoffs, and risks. Work directly with Brand Creative leadership to continually raise the quality of the work and build one of the strongest in-house creative teams in the industry. What you’ll bring: Significant experience leading complex, multidisciplinary creative production, with a track record of independently owning large-scale campaigns and multiple concurrent creative projects. Deep production experience across film, photography, motion, experiential, digital, and integrated brand work, with the judgment to choose the right production model for the idea. Strong financial and operational judgment, including experience with scoping, staffing, budgeting, forecasting, and managing meaningful production investments. A track record of building production systems, capabilities, or ways of working, not simply operating within established ones. Experience building and managing an exceptional network of agencies, production companies, directors, studios, freelancers, and vendors. Strong creative judgment and the confidence to challenge briefs, protect ambitious ideas, and make difficult tradeoffs without losing sight of the work. Exceptional communication and partnership skills across creative teams, marketers, executives, and external partners. The ability to bring calm, clarity, and sound judgment to ambiguity. You're excited to build the function from the ground up and still want to personally produce the work. Mercury values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities or special needs. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role. Total Rewards The total rewards package at Mercury includes base salary, equity (stock options/RSUs), and benefits. Our salary and equity ranges are highly competitive within the SaaS and fintech industry and are updated regularly using the most reliable compensation survey data for our industry. New hire offers are made based on a candidate’s experience, expertise, geographic location, and internal pay equity relative to peers. Our target new hire base salary ranges for this role are the following : US employees in New York City, Los Angeles, Seattle, or the San Francisco Bay Area: $189,400—$236,700 USD US employees outside of New York City, Los Angeles, Seattle, or the San Francisco Bay Area: $170,400—$213,000 USD Canadian employees (any location): $179,000—$223,700 CAD

review_candidates.title: Executive Education Program Coordinator
review_candidates.description: Join us and shape the future of hospitality today! EHL's dynamic campuses form a unique network where passionate students, academics and industry experts from over 120 countries come together with a common goal: to develop and disseminate hospitality knowledge, while supporting the sector's continued growth. We are constantly striving to improve the working environment and personal development opportunities for our more than 800 staff and teachers, who are among the most recognized experts in their respective fields. Since its foundation in 1893, EHL has been widely recognized by the industry and consistently ranked among the world's top hospitality management schools. Everything we do is based on our values of excellence, family and learning, and we are committed to bringing them to life in tangible ways for our employees. The Graduate and Executive Education segment is a dynamic and fast-growing business unit of EHL Hospitality Business School. It has a growing portfolio of diverse offerings including short and open programs, custom programs, training solutions for professionals and organizations as well as the organization of study tours. It is also home to research institutes including the Institute of Customer Experience Management, Institute of Business Creativity, Hospitality Real Estate & Finance Institute, and Institute of Nutrition R&D. To join our amazing team, we are looking for a candidate who is not only skilled and passionate about hospitality but also aligns with our leadership principles: transparency, accountability, collaboration, care, and experimentation. The Executive Education Program Coordinator is responsible for the end-to-end coordination and delivery of executive education programs, including custom, open-enrolment, and online offerings. Working closely with the Program Management teams, faculty, and internal and external stakeholders, the role ensures seamless program implementation, coordinates operational and logistical requirements, supports continuous process improvement, and manages program budgets and financial administration to deliver an exceptional client and learner experience. What will you do? Coordinate end-to-end logistics for program delivery, including scheduling, venue selection, participant accommodations, and facility requirements. Manage the delivery of assigned virtual, residential, and blended programs, ensuring a seamless experience for clients and learners. Liaise with internal and external vendors, service providers, and clients to coordinate program requirements and ensure smooth execution. Coordinate event and technical support, including AV, video recordings, simultaneous interpretation, and virtual sessions. Apply, maintain, and continuously improve established workflows, tools, and processes to optimize program implementation and enhance the client and learner experience. Collaborate with the Program Management team to streamline operations and ensure effective program delivery. Provide administrative support to program faculty, including scheduling, travel arrangements, and reimbursements. Collect, maintain, and analyze program data to support post-program reviews, participation statistics, and reporting. Manage program budgets and financial administration, including expense monitoring and purchase orders. Ensure compliance with relevant regulations, institutional policies, and established procedures. Who are you? You have a Bachelor’s degree in a business-related field. You have at least 3 years of professional experience in program coordination and/or event organization and management. You are proactive, autonomous, and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously. You have a strong service orientation and excellent attention to detail. You have excellent communication and interpersonal skills in a business environment. You are a collaborative team player with a demonstrated ability to work effectively in multicultural environments. You have strong proficiency in Microsoft Office and are confident working with digital tools and systems, including CRM, LMS, and online collaboration platforms. You are available to travel occasionally and flexible in your working hours, including outside regular business hours, to support the needs of an international clientele. You have, or are eager to develop, a strong understanding of the Executive Education market. You are fluent in English and French; additional languages are considered a strong asset. What we offer? We offer you a permanent contract within a business area of an educational institution, with exceptional employee benefits including free meals, an attractive number of days off, a parking space or public transport contribution, as well as access to various services and facilities. We offer you responsibility, challenge, development opportunities and encouragement to help you achieve your professional and personal goals. We offer you the opportunity to make a tangible impact on our students’, staff and partners’ experience as well as contribute to the growth of our institution. You will enjoy being part of a passionate, multidisciplinary and talented team.
